fact: A revised school-level EMIS lets schools capture and validate data electronically, replacing paper records at schools such as Masvingo Government Primary School; all 1,444 public schools in Masvingo Province use it, 12,324 schools nationwide have been equipped to use it, and GPE funds it with US$2.9 million (2023-2026) with UNICEF implementation support.
title: Data systems transform Zimbabwe's schools
